gitCommit.subject: fix(sorting): announce the decision loop, and fix the refresh that raced navigation (e2zj, l5gd, hzwj) (#321)
gitCommit.body:
fix(sorting): announce the decision loop, and fix the refresh that raced navigation (e2zj, l5gd, hzwj) (#321)

a11y (purses-e2zj, WCAG 2.1 AA). The decision loop is the core of the app and it
was silent:
- CompareChoice and DecisionControls had NO live region, so a screen-reader user
  got no announcement when a choice registered and the next pair loaded — the
  screen changed under them (SC 4.1.3).
- The first fix was theater and review caught it: every production caller passes
  kind:"local", and the announcement sat BELOW the `if (kind === "local") return`
  early return, so the region shipped permanently empty. The original test only
  went green because it constructed kind:"session" itself.
- Both parents rendered <DecisionControls key={shown.item.id}>, remounting the
  region on every advance. A live region that appears together with its content
  is not announced. Dropped the key.
- Triage runs Love, Love, Love — identical text is not re-announced, so the
  setter nudges the string. Without that one line the fix does nothing.
- TierBadge with showLabel={false} rendered an aria-hidden glyph and no label:
  no accessible name at all (SC 1.1.1/4.1.2). Now role="img" + aria-label.
- SharePanel nested a <Button> inside a <Link> — invalid, duplicate tab stop,
  ambiguous role (SC 4.1.2).

purses-l5gd. PhotoUpload announced neither progress nor success: the copy lived
only in button text (announced only if focus happened to rest there), and success
was window.location.reload(), which tears down the a11y tree and drops the AT
cursor into a fresh document. Now a persistent sr-only role=status (mounted EMPTY
at first render — the assertion that actually pins the bug) + router.refresh().

purses-hzwj. The round-end router.refresh() raced the navigation to /compare and
the goto aborted — if Playwright can lose that navigation, a human on a slow
tablet can drop a tap. The refresh existed to defeat Next 14's 30s dynamic RSC
cache (returning to the hub would show pre-round copy). Fixed the CAUSE, not the
symptom: experimental.staleTimes.dynamic = 0 (Next 15's default), so the page
isn't stale and the refresh isn't needed. The e2e's bounded-retry workaround is
gone, so the spec proves the race is closed rather than absorbing it.

Copy per TONE.md: gentle, no counts, no tally, no scold. SharePanel's "Failed to
create/revoke share link" also replaced — the revoke message now says the link is
still shared, which "Failed to revoke" left ambiguous at exactly the wrong moment.

Gates: lint 0 errors, test:ci 1295 passed, test:db 652 passed, build, auth:verify.
